A.title: Capex intent & spend
A.read: IREN confirms delivery timing, not weak demand; AT&S pricing and AMD-backed substrate commitments reinforce supply tightness. Big-4 capex/OCF near 115% remains the weak spot.

B.title: Financing & credit
B.read: Neocloud and IPO stress remain dominant. Anthropic investors reportedly seek a lower valuation or delay; TeraWulf needs a Google backstop; ING is reportedly auctioning data-center loans. No default or qualifying IPO pull yet.

C.title: Demand & unit economics
C.read: GPU rents remain firm: H100 20-session $3.12 and B200 $9.39 through Nov 5 (reported). IREN contracts show customer prepayment and higher H100 pricing; demand-caused cancellations remain absent.

D.title: Physical constraints
D.read: Permit and grid constraints remain red. Microsoft’s reported Nscale unsigned LOI exit is a watch hit, not demand-driven capacity retreat. ING’s Jupiter loan slice carries power and permit delays, not demand/cost.

E.title: Macro & markets
E.read: The Nov 5 rout deepened an already-red E4: SOX closed 16.8% below its 200-day with breadth 13 of 99. Hot October jobs reinforce 42 Macro’s inflation frame; E5 remains amber pending a Nov 6 Leadoff.

key_takeaway: SHIFTS: none. Composite 49.2 AMBER (30.0 ÷ 61; 7R/12A/10G; 0.8 under RED). The Nov 5 AI rout deepened E4, already red: SOX −16.8% below its 200-day, −38.4% from its high, and only 13 of 99 AI names above their 50-day. Financing and physical delivery remain stressed while GPU rents and supplier demand hold. Nearest RED: E5 or E6 → 50.8. Inform only — no trades.
pattern: Financing and permitting keep cracking before supplier volumes. Credit spreads on levered builders, the IPO window and data-center permits are under stress, while GPU rents, IREN pricing and AT&S/AMD supply commitments have not rolled. That keeps the immediate hinge between a positioning reset and a physical-demand break.
decisive: Financing window shut for good — lab/neocloud IPO pulled or GPU-backed loan default (T-15)
Hyperscaler cancelling capacity for demand reasons rather than grid (D2b), or Big-4 capex outrunning OCF while 2027 guides decelerate (T-16)
